set.body:
Objective:
Freeze Frame as an extraction-ready, general relational library incubating in this repository but independent of ScalaFIM and Gale. Prove the defining Scala 3.7+ API before committing to storage or engine internals.

Architecture decisions:
- Neutral package and artifact identity; no scalafim or gale types in frame-core.
- Frame core owns schema, nullability, expression and logical-plan semantics.
- Runtime schemas are facts; typed named-tuple schemas are evidence obtained by one validation boundary.
- Dynamic and typed APIs lower to one resolved logical IR.
- Gale, DuckDB, Parquet, and ScalaFIM are adapters or consumers, never parents.
- Plans contain immutable source descriptions, not open resources or captured closures.

Acceptance:
- A written architecture contract records dependency direction, package layout, core/non-core boundaries, error model, and extraction rules.
- A Scala 3.7+ compile spike demonstrates dynamic binding, TypedFrame promotion, named-tuple expression scopes, typed projection, outer-join nullability, and compile-time rejection of missing or mistyped fields.
- Nullability is a field/expression property, separate from logical type and physical encoding.
- Compile-time behavior is measured on representative narrow and wide schemas.
- The spike runs on JVM and Scala.js or records a concrete compiler/platform blocker without weakening the design.
set.title: Frame foundation 0: freeze independent architecture and Scala 3.7 typed-API spike
